articles.author: Crispus Nyaga
articles.headline: Micron Is Up 285% So Far This Year. Will It Surge or Crash After Earnings?
articles.summary: Micron stock has jumped by 285% this year, helped by the ongoing memory chip shortage. Its earnings reports will be crucial.
articles._summary: MU stock has soared this year, mirroring the gains of companies in the memory industry like Samsung Electronics, SK Hynix, and Western Digital (NASDAQ: WDC ) . This surge has accelerated because of the ongoing supply shortage, which has led to a surge in prices, a trend that may continue over time. As a result, its revenue growth has accelerated, with the second quarter figure rising by 75% QoQ to $23 billion. This increase was up by 196% from the same period last year.
articles._zh_headline: 美光今年迄今已上涨 285%。盈利后会飙升还是崩盘？

articles.headline: Lebanese turtle conservationist Mona Khalil killed by Israeli strike
articles.summary: Mona Khalil, who had refused to leave the beach she had spent years protecting, died from her injuries after the Israeli strike.
articles._summary: Lebanese environmental activist Mona Khalil, whose work helped turn a stretch of coastline in southern Lebanon into one of the eastern Mediterranean's most important nesting sites for endangered sea turtles, has died after being wounded in an Israeli strike. Khalil, 76, was injured when her house on Mansouri beach, near the southern city of Tyre, was hit during Israeli attacks in southern Lebanon two weeks ago. She died on Friday after several days in hospital, according to a local environmental group. Her death came as Israeli air strikes intensified across southern Lebanon, raising concerns about renewed violence despite diplomatic efforts to maintain a fragile regional peace. The BBC has reached out to the Israeli military for a response. "She is a deeply committed environmental defender," Hisham Younes, the founder and president of Green Southerners, told the BBC.
articles._zh_headline: 黎巴嫩海龟保护主义者莫娜·哈利勒在以色列袭击中丧生
articles._zh_summary: 黎巴嫩环保活动人士莫娜·哈利勒在以色列的一次袭击中受伤后去世，她的工作帮助将黎巴嫩南部的一段海岸线变成了地中海东部最重要的濒危海龟筑巢地之一。两周前，以色列对黎巴嫩南部发动袭击，76 岁的哈利勒位于南部城市提尔附近曼苏里海滩的房屋遭到袭击，她受伤。据当地环保组织称，她在医院几天后于周五去世。她去世之际，以色列加强了对黎巴嫩南部的空袭，引发了人们对暴力事件再次发生的担忧，尽管外交努力维持了脆弱的地区和平。 BBC 已联系以色列军方寻求回应。 “她是一位坚定的环保卫士，”绿色南方人组织的创始人兼总裁希沙姆·尤尼斯 (Hisham Younes) 告诉英国广播公司 (BBC)。

articles.headline: Iran says Strait of Hormuz will be closed over Israel attacks on Lebanon
articles.summary: Iran said Israel's continued attacks in Lebanon are a breach of Tehran's agreement with the US to end the war.
articles._summary: The Iranian military says it has closed the Strait of Hormuz again over Israel's attacks on southern Lebanon. Iran said Israel's continued attacks in Lebanon are a breach of Tehran's agreement with the US to end the war. "Do not approach the Strait of Hormuz; otherwise, your security will be jeopardized," Iran's Revolutionary Guard Corps Navy said. The US-Iran deal includes the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz - a shipping channel through which about 20% of the world's oil and liquefied natural gas passes. About two dozen people have reportedly been killed by Israeli airstrikes on southern Lebanon, less than 24 hours after a new ceasefire between Israel and Hezbollah was announced. The Iranian military accused the US of violating the US-Iran deal by not implementing the first clause in the 14-point memorandum of understanding , which agrees to "the immediate and permanent termination of military operations on all fronts, including in Lebanon".
articles._zh_headline: 伊朗表示将因以色列袭击黎巴嫩而关闭霍尔木兹海峡
articles._zh_summary: 伊朗军方表示，由于以色列袭击黎巴嫩南部，他们已再次关闭霍尔木兹海峡。伊朗表示，以色列对黎巴嫩的持续袭击违反了德黑兰与美国达成的结束战争协议。伊朗革命卫队海军表示：“不要接近霍尔木兹海峡；否则，你们的安全将受到威胁。”美伊协议包括重新开放霍尔木兹海峡——世界上约 20% 的石油和液化天然气都要经过这条航运通道。据报道，在以色列和真主党宣布新的停火不到 24 小时后，以色列对黎巴嫩南部的空袭造成约 20 人死亡。伊朗军方指责美国违反了美伊协议，没有执行14点谅解备忘录中的第一项，即“立即永久终止包括在黎巴嫩在内的所有战线的军事行动”。

articles.author: Crispus Nyaga
articles.headline: Crude Oil Price Pops As Iran Closes Strait Of Hormuz
articles.summary: Brent and WTI crude oil benchmarks are rising today after Iran closed the Strait of Hormuz following the ongoing fighting in Lebanon.
articles._summary: Crude oil prices jumped today, June 20, on popular perpetual futures marketplaces like Hyperliquid and Aster, after Iran announced the sudden closure of the Strait of Hormuz. WTI jumped to $79, while Brent rose to $82. The two popular benchmarks have risen by 7% from their lowest levels this month. Iran has closed the Strait of Hormuz, citing the ongoing skirmishes in Lebanon and Gaza. This closure happened after Israel continued its strikes against Lebanon, killing at least 16 people. According to Reuters , Israel said that its strikes in South Lebanon were a response to Hezbollah attacks. It noted that Hezbollah launched over 50 projectiles towards Israel. At the same time, Hezbollah said that it would not allow Israel "freedom of movement" in Lebanon. Iran closed the Strait of Hormuz because peace in Lebanon is one of the 14 points of the deal that President Donald Trump and his Iranian counterpart signed this week.
articles._zh_headline: 伊朗关闭霍尔木兹海峡，原油价格上涨
articles._zh_summary: 伊朗宣布突然关闭霍尔木兹海峡后，6 月 20 日，Hyperliquid 和 Aster 等热门永续期货市场上的原油价格大幅上涨。 WTI 涨至 79 美元，布伦特原油涨至 82 美元。这两个受欢迎的基准指数较本月最低水平上涨了 7%。伊朗以黎巴嫩和加沙地带持续发生的小冲突为由，关闭了霍尔木兹海峡。此次关闭是在以色列继续袭击黎巴嫩并造成至少 16 人死亡之后发生的。据路透社报道，以色列表示，对黎巴嫩南部的袭击是对真主党袭击的回应。报告指出，真主党向以色列发射了 50 多枚射弹。与此同时，真主党表示不会允许以色列在黎巴嫩“行动自由”。伊朗关闭霍尔木兹海峡，因为黎巴嫩和平是唐纳德·特朗普总统和伊朗总统本周签署的协议的 14 点之一。

articles.headline: Peace Talks Stall as Lebanon Fighting Escalates, Iran Closes Hormuz
articles.summary: Talks to end the war in the Middle East have stalled amid intense fighting between Israel and Hezbollah in southern Lebanon.
articles._summary: Talks between the US and Iran to end the nearly four‑month war in the Middle East have stalled amid intense fighting between Israel and Hezbollah in southern Lebanon. On Saturday, Iran again shut down passage through the Strait of Hormuz over the fighting. Iran has delayed negotiations that were meant to begin in Switzerland on Friday because of the ongoing fighting, Iran’s state-run broadcaster Press TV reported , citing Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesman Esmaeil Baghaei . Israeli attacks in southern Lebanon have violated the interim peace deal, he said. Under the terms of the agreement, the war on all fronts, including in Lebanon, should immediately end, Baghaei said. The US must also lift its naval blockade against Iran for the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz to commercial shipping, he said. The stalled talks and renewed clashes have injected fresh volatility into energy markets, with traders watching for any disruption to crude flows through the Strait of Hormuz.
articles._zh_headline: 黎巴嫩战斗升级，伊朗关闭霍尔木兹海峡，和平谈判陷入僵局
articles._zh_summary: 由于以色列和黎巴嫩真主党之间的激烈战斗，美国和伊朗之间结束近四个月中东战争的谈判陷入僵局。 周六，伊朗因战斗再次关闭霍尔木兹海峡的通道。伊朗国营广播公司 Press TV 援引伊朗外交部发言人埃斯梅尔·巴格哈伊 (Esmaeil Baghaei) 的话报道称，由于持续的战斗，伊朗推迟了原定于周五在瑞士开始的谈判。他说，以色列对黎巴嫩南部的袭击违反了临时和平协议。巴加伊说，根据协议条款，包括黎巴嫩在内的所有战线的战争应立即结束。他说，美国还必须解除对伊朗的海上封锁，以重新开放霍尔木兹海峡的商业航运。陷入僵局的谈判和重新爆发的冲突给能源市场带来了新的波动，交易员们正在关注霍尔木兹海峡原油流动是否受到干扰。

articles.headline: Iran Has Closed Strait of Hormuz Over Israeli Strikes in Lebanon
articles.summary: Iran said on Saturday it had shut the Strait of Hormuz again, a move that could disrupt a critical corridor for global crude shipments.
articles._summary: Iran said on Saturday it had shut the Strait of Hormuz again, a move that could disrupt a critical corridor for global crude shipments. The announcement tied the decision to what Tehran described as ceasefire breaches by the United States and Israel, along with ongoing Israeli military activity in Lebanon. According to Iran’s state-run Mehr news agency, the order came from the Khatam al-Anbiya Central Headquarters, which it the country’s top joint military command. Mehr reported the command warned the closure was only a "first step," adding that further measures could follow if what Iran called aggression persists. The move lands only days after a U.S.-backed arrangement aimed at easing months of fighting and allowing vessels to resume transiting the waterway. Tankers had started using the route again after that agreement, according to the report.

articles.headline: African and Caribbean nations call for formal apology for transatlantic slavery
articles.summary: The leaders have asked for apologies from the countries that benefited from the slave trade, as well as debt relief and financial compensation.
articles._summary: African and Caribbean countries have called for a formal apology and reparations from countries that benefited from the transatlantic slave trade. The demands come at the end of a three day conference in Ghana which looked to advance the push for reparatory justice. It follows a landmark UN resolution earlier in March which recognised transatlantic slavery as the "gravest crime against humanity", urging UN member states to contribute to a reparations fund. Around 12-15 million African men, women and children were captured and trafficked to the Americas to work as slaves from the 15-19th century. A 19-point reparations plan has been endorsed as part of the "Next Steps" conference in the Ghanaian capital of Accra. It calls for comprehensive debt relief, the restitution of looted cultural property, and the establishment of a global reparations fund, though no specific amount was stated. It also addresses the disproportionate impact of slavery on African women and girls.

articles._zh_summary: 非洲和加勒比国家呼吁从跨大西洋奴隶贸易中受益的国家正式道歉并做出赔偿。这些要求是在加纳举行的为期三天的会议结束时提出的，该会议旨在推动赔偿性司法的进程。此前，联合国于三月初通过了一项具有里程碑意义的决议，该决议承认跨大西洋奴隶制是“最严重的危害人类罪”，并敦促联合国成员国为赔偿基金捐款。从 15 世纪到 19 世纪，大约有 12-1500 万非洲男人、女人和儿童被俘虏并被贩运到美洲充当奴隶。作为在加纳首都阿克拉举行的“下一步”会议的一部分，一项 19 点赔偿计划已得到批准。它呼吁全面减免债务，归还被掠夺的文化财产，并建立全球赔偿基金，但没有说明具体数额。它还解决了奴隶制对非洲妇女和女童造成的过度影响。

articles.headline: Israel and Hezbollah agree ceasefire, US says, as more Lebanon strikes reported
articles.summary: The agreement followed concerns that continued clashes would undermine the deal to end the war between the US and Iran.
articles._summary: Israel and Hezbollah have agreed a ceasefire, a US official says, following intense Israeli air strikes in southern Lebanon that killed 47 people. The latest agreement followed concerns that continued clashes, which also saw Hezbollah kill four Israeli soldiers in Lebanon, would undermine the deal to end the war between the US and Iran. The Israeli military confirmed that a ceasefire was in effect, but later a spokesman said its forces would "continue to remove immediate threats". Hezbollah is yet to confirm the ceasefire but its secretary general, Sheikh Naim Qassem, said: "The project to eliminate Hezbollah has failed." Rescue officials in the city of Nabatieh told the BBC there had been at least 12 air strikes since the ceasefire began at 16:00 local time (13:00 GMT). The deadly escalation is another sign that Donald Trump is not necessarily in control of the fate of his deal with Iran.
articles._zh_headline: 美国表示，以色列和真主党同意停火，据报道黎巴嫩发生更多袭击
articles._zh_summary: 一名美国官员表示，在以色列对黎巴嫩南部发动猛烈空袭并造成 47 人死亡后，以色列和真主党已同意停火。最新的协议是在人们担心持续的冲突（真主党在黎巴嫩杀死了四名以色列士兵）将破坏结束美国和伊朗之间战争的协议之后达成的。以色列军方证实停火已经生效，但随后发言人表示，其部队将“继续消除眼前的威胁”。真主党尚未确认停火，但其秘书长谢赫·纳伊姆·卡西姆表示：“消灭真主党的计划已经失败。”纳巴蒂耶市的救援官员告诉 BBC，自当地时间 16:00（格林威治标准时间 13:00）停火开始以来，至少发生了 12 次空袭。致命的升级是唐纳德·特朗普不一定能控制他与伊朗协议命运的另一个迹象。

articles.headline: Italy's Meloni says Trump 'made up' story that she 'begged' him for photo at G7
articles.summary: The highly public exchange is an indication that their earlier close ties have frayed  since Trump's decision to go to war with Iran.
articles._summary: Italy's prime minister, Giorgia Meloni, has said she is astonished after President Donald Trump told Italian TV she had "begged" him for a picture with her, in comments that have provoked an open row between the two leaders. Meloni said Trump's comments were entirely "made-up", and Italian Foreign Minister Antonio Tajani has cancelled a trip to the US early next week. The highly public exchange is an indication of how far their earlier close ties have frayed in the months since Trump's decision to go to war with Iran. Trump and Meloni were seen in close conversation at the G7 summit at Evian-les-Bains in eastern France this week, and the Italian leader later told reporters their relationship was unchanged and there had been "no recriminations". However, Trump has since given a phone interview with Italy's La7 TV channel in which he alleged: "She begged me to take a photo with her; I felt sorry for her."
articles._zh_headline: 意大利的梅洛尼称特朗普“编造”了她“恳求”他在七国集团峰会上合影的故事
articles._zh_summary: 意大利总理乔治亚·梅洛尼表示，唐纳德·特朗普总统告诉意大利电视台，她“请求”他与她合影，她对此感到惊讶，这些言论引发了两国领导人之间的公开争吵。梅洛尼表示，特朗普的言论完全是“捏造的”，意大利外交部长安东尼奥·塔亚尼已取消下周初的美国之行。这种高度公开的交流表明，自特朗普决定与伊朗开战以来的几个月里，他们早先的密切关系已经恶化到何种程度。人们看到特朗普和梅洛尼本周在法国东部埃维昂莱班举行的七国集团峰会上进行了密切交谈，这位意大利领导人后来告诉记者，他们的关系没有改变，并且“没有相互指责”。然而，特朗普此后接受了意大利La7电视频道的电话采访，他在采访中声称：“她求我和她合影；我为她感到难过。”
